title: Annotatio III open §.I: Landgrave Philip of Hesse tries to smother Dissensus in the bud — letters to Luther, Melanchthon, Brentius
pass_a_gloss: ANNOTATIO III. On the Efforts undertaken for Consociation, at pages 334 to 341. §. I. As soon as the Dissensus had first sprung up, the Landgrave of Hesse Philip — who cannot be praised enough — tried to smother that thing in the very blade of grass,
pass_b_english: ANNOTATIO III. On the Attempts Made toward Consociation (pages 334–341).
§. I. The moment the Dissensus first broke out, Landgrave Philip of Hesse — a prince hard to praise enough — tried to choke it off in the bud.
source_text:
ANNOTATIO III.
De Moliminibus pro Consociatione susceptis, ad pag. 334. ad 341.
§. I.
Simulac Dissensus initium subortum fuisset, in ipsa herba suffocare illud annisus est nullis satis laudibus evehendus Landgravius Hassiae Philippus,

to smother in the very blade/herb

choices.why: organized Consociation enterprises, not mere wishes
